situation.en: 7 armed incidents were reported in Somalia in the past seven days, 77% fewer than the week before. Most were armed clashs (57%), followed by armed assaults (29%). 1 of them were carried by two or more outlets. The most reported locations over the past month were Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland. UCDP lists 4 active armed conflicts here, the oldest dating from 1982.
situation.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser ble meldt i Somalia de siste sju dagene, 77 prosent færre enn uken før. Flest gjaldt væpnet sammenstøt (57 prosent), deretter væpnet angrep (29 prosent). 1 av dem ble omtalt av to eller flere medier. De mest omtalte stedene den siste måneden var Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland. UCDP fører 4 aktive væpnede konflikter her, den eldste fra 1982.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
